text: Mechanical engineering is an engineering discipline centered around "design, manufacture, and operation of various mechanical equipment". From small components like watch gears and surgical knives to large-scale items such as high-speed trains, industrial robots, and space shuttles, the technical support of mechanical engineering is behind almost all tangible mechanical products. It is the "skeleton" of modern industry and also a bridge connecting basic science and engineering applications. It is hailed as the "mother of engineering disciplines".
